frames.heading: Zapp
frames.body: Boogie on down to funky town! The name's Zapp, welcome to Funkopolis.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Hello Zapp! We're here to save your planet from the Grand Composer's tyrrany!

frames.heading: Zapp
frames.body: Aw yeah, it's about time! But I must warn you, the Grand Composer has strengthened his grip in our land. You'll need to up the groove to defeat him!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Man, I have the perfect thing! Player, your funk training has reached the point to unleash Disco Fever!

frames.heading: Mojo
frames.body: Hit two thumbs up to amplify your groove energy!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Thanks Mojo! Zapp, I'll do whatever it takes to save your planet.
